items.title: Factoring a map from a uniform module through a sufficiently negative shift of the ideal powers
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a factorisation statement for maps from a uniformly annihilated module into a quotient of ideal powers (author lemma at source lines 5330-5342, label lemma-factor-hom): under an explicit numerical hypothesis on the exponent, the composition of the given map with a shift map factors through elements of a power of the ideal. The proof (source lines 5344-5448) pulls the map back along the canonical system of maps to the closed subschemes, passes to duals where the required annihilation is available, and then exhibits the factorisation with explicit constants; the remaining dimension cases are stated by the author to run identically (proof lines 5442-5448). The pullback-and-dualise step together with the constant bookkeeping is the content. H2.
